reels.title: Welcome Beam: a 501B open model you can own, customize, and scale

editorial_notes.reasoning: The 501B 'Beam' model represents a massive leap in parameter scale for open-source, offering high visual potential for illustrating how massive models are compressed or partitioned.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What happens when you squeeze a 501-billion parameter brain into an open-source box you can actually own?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A giant library where the librarian (the model) has memorized every book, yet you can fit the entire building into your own personal backpack.
